fullDescription: An editorial one-quote-at-a-time TESTIMONIAL CAROUSEL on warm cream paper: a big soft-serif Fraunces blockquote with a burgundy quote mark above a gradient monogram avatar, cross-fading slides with circular prev/next arrows and a dot row whose active dot stretches into a burgundy pill, embedded in a full one-pager (sticky nav, hero, dark-ink stats strip, how-it-works cards, burgundy CTA) with a single deep-burgundy accent.

structured.summary: An editorial TESTIMONIAL CAROUSEL on a warm cream paper page for an AI product design agent ('Praise'). One quote is shown at a time, centered and large: a soft burgundy quote-mark glyph, an oversized light-weight Fraunces serif blockquote, then a gradient monogram avatar (initials) ringed in cream above the maker's name + role. Slides cross-fade with a gentle rise (opacity + 14px translateY), driven by circular prev/next arrows and a row of dot indicators where the active dot stretches into a burgundy pill; it auto-advances every 6.5s and also responds to arrow keys. The carousel is embedded live in a real one-page site: a sticky cream/blur nav (a burgundy quote-mark logo tile + 'Praise.' wordmark + Voices/Proof/How-it-works links + an ink 'Start designing' pill), a centered hero (an eyebrow pill 'From the people who ship with us' + a big two-line serif headline 'What designers say when the canvas answers back' with 'answers back' in burgundy italic + a sub), the carousel section, a full-bleed dark-ink stats strip (57k+ / <60s / 4.9/5), a 'Three steps, one canvas' how-it-works card trio, a full-bleed burgundy CTA, and a footer. Everything reflows cleanly to a single centered column on mobile.

style.description: Warm, editorial, premium-print aesthetic. Surfaces are a cream paper (#faf6ef page over #f3ecdf 'cream-2' cards), text is a warm near-black ink (#1c1815) with a softer brown 'ink-soft' (#4a423b) for body/secondary, and a single deep burgundy accent (#7b2d3b, with a darker burgundy-deep #5e1f2b for gradient stops) carries the logo tile, the eyebrow, the italic headline word, the quote mark, the avatar gradients, the active dot, and the full-bleed CTA. Two full-bleed bands invert the palette: a dark ink (#1c1815) stats strip with cream text and burgundy '+/s//5' accents, and a solid burgundy CTA band with cream text. Typography is the signature: Fraunces (a soft-optical serif, font-variation-settings 'SOFT' 40 'WONK' 0) for all display/headlines/blockquotes/numerals at a light 300 weight with tight tracking, paired with Inter (400/500/600) for nav, body, labels, and meta. Depth is soft and quiet: a faint radial-dot 'grain' texture (radial-gradient(rgba(28,24,21,0.035) 1px, transparent 1px) at 4px tiles) sits behind the cream sections, the avatar carries a soft shadow + a 4px cream ring, and borders are ink/10 hairlines. Motion is gentle and slow: slides cross-fade over .6s on a cubic-bezier(.22,.61,.36,1) ease while rising 14px, the active dot animates its width to 28px over .35s, nav links grow a 1px burgundy underline on hover, and control buttons lift translateY(-2px) on hover. Corners are pill-round on chrome (rounded-full nav pills, arrows, dots, avatar) and rounded-2xl on the how-it-works cards. Selection is burgundy-on-cream.
style.prompt: Design a warm, editorial, premium-print testimonial UI. Palette EXACTLY: page background cream #faf6ef with cream-2 #f3ecdf for the how-it-works cards; text ink #1c1815 (warm near-black) for headings with ink-soft #4a423b (soft brown) for body, nav links, and secondary copy; a single deep-burgundy accent #7b2d3b with burgundy-deep #5e1f2b as the darker gradient stop, used for the logo tile, the eyebrow pill, the italic headline word, the quote-mark glyph, the avatar gradients, the active dot/pill, and the full-bleed CTA band. Two full-bleed inverted bands: a dark ink #1c1815 stats strip with cream #faf6ef text and burgundy '+', 's', '/5' accents, and a solid burgundy #7b2d3b CTA band with cream text and a cream button. Fonts: load Fraunces (ital,opsz 9..144, wght 300..900) and Inter (400;500;600) from Google Fonts. Use Fraunces for ALL display: the wordmark, the hero h1, the blockquotes, section headings, the big stat numerals, and the step numbers, set LIGHT (font-weight 300, 'font-light') with tight tracking (tracking-tight) and a soft optical setting via font-optical-sizing:auto and font-variation-settings:'SOFT' 40,'WONK' 0; use Inter for nav, body paragraphs, eyebrow/label text, the avatar meta, and buttons. Headline scales 2.7rem -> sm:6rem -> md:4.5rem, leading ~1.04; blockquotes 1.7rem -> sm:3xl -> md:2.6rem, leading ~1.28-1.32; stat numerals text-5xl -> md:6xl. Depth must stay soft and quiet: behind the cream sections add a 'grain' texture = background-image radial-gradient(rgba(28,24,21,0.035) 1px, transparent 1px); background-size 4px 4px; the monogram avatar is a 16x16 rounded-full gradient (from-burgundy to-burgundy-deep / from-ink to-ink-soft / from-burgundy-deep to-ink) with cream initials, a ring-4 ring-cream, and a soft shadow-lg burgundy/ink-tinted; borders are ink/10 hairlines. Motion: slides are absolutely-stacked and cross-fade with opacity + transform translateY(14px)->0 over .6s cubic-bezier(.22,.61,.36,1); the active dot animates width to 28px over .35s; nav links grow a 1px burgundy underline (::after, width 0->100%) on hover; circular control buttons translateY(-2px) on hover and back on active. Corners: rounded-full on the logo tile, nav pills, control arrows, dots, and avatar; rounded-2xl on the how-it-works cards. ::selection is background #7b2d3b color #faf6ef. Icons are inline SVG only: a custom double-quote-mark glyph (used as the logo, the big slide quote at burgundy/25, and the footer mark) and stroked arrow/control icons (caret arrows for prev/next, an up-right arrow on the CTA buttons). Tone: literary, confident, warm; airy whitespace, generous vertical rhythm.

layout_and_structure.description: A single-quote-at-a-time testimonial carousel as the centerpiece of a one-page site, everything centered. Order top to bottom: a sticky cream/blur nav, a centered hero (eyebrow pill + big two-line serif headline + sub), THE carousel section (centered slides that cross-fade, with circular prev/next arrows + a dot/pill indicator row below), a full-bleed dark-ink 3-up stats strip, a 'Three steps, one canvas' how-it-works card trio, a full-bleed burgundy CTA band, and a footer. Content sits in centered max-w columns (max-w-6xl for the chrome/stats/how, max-w-4xl for the carousel + CTA) with px-6 md:px-10 gutters. On mobile the nav center links hide (the logo + 'Start designing' pill persist), the headline drops its line-break, the stats and steps stack to one column, and the footer goes column.

prompts.prompt: A sticky top-0 z-50 header on cream/85 (#faf6ef at 85%) with backdrop-blur-md and a border-b border-ink/10. Inside a centered max-w-6xl px-6 md:px-10 h-16 flex row items-center justify-between. Left: a logo link = a grid-place-items-center w-8 h-8 rounded-full burgundy #7b2d3b tile holding a 15px cream double-quote-mark SVG glyph, beside a Fraunces text-xl tracking-tight wordmark 'Praise' with a burgundy '.'. Center (hidden, md:flex, gap-9): three 14px ink-soft #4a423b Inter links 'Voices', 'Proof', 'How it works', each a .nav-link that darkens to ink and grows a 1px burgundy underline (::after width 0->100% over .3s) on hover. Right: a primary pill = inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full bg-ink #1c1815 text-cream text-sm px-5 py-2.5 reading 'Start designing' with a small stroked up-right arrow SVG, hover:bg-burgundy.

A centered hero on the cream 'grain' section, inside max-w-6xl px-6 md:px-10, pt-20 md:pt-28 pb-4, text-center. Top: an inline-flex eyebrow pill = rounded-full border border-burgundy/30 bg-burgundy/5 px-4 py-1.5, text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.18em] burgundy #7b2d3b, with a leading 1.5px burgundy dot, reading 'From the people who ship with us'. Then an mt-7 Fraunces (soft optical, font-light) h1 at text-[2.7rem] leading-[1.04] -> sm:text-6xl -> md:text-[4.5rem], tracking-tight, reading 'What designers say' / (a sm+
) 'when the canvas' + an italic burgundy ' answers back'. Then a mx-auto mt-6 max-w-xl Inter text-base md:text-lg ink-soft leading-relaxed sub: 'A prompt-driven design agent that turns a sentence into shippable UI. Here is what people built, in their own words.'

The centerpiece: a relative section inside a centered max-w-4xl px-6 md:px-10 pt-10 md:pt-14 pb-24. A #carousel relative wrapper holds a relative slide stack: each .slide is absolutely stacked (position:absolute inset-0, opacity 0, translateY(14px), pointer-events none) and the .is-active one becomes position:relative, opacity 1, translateY(0), pointer-events auto, transitioning opacity+transform over .6s cubic-bezier(.22,.61,.36,1). Each slide is a flex flex-col items-center text-center: a 68px burgundy/25 double-quote-mark SVG, then a Fraunces (soft optical) font-light blockquote at text-[1.7rem] leading-[1.32] -> sm:text-3xl -> md:text-[2.6rem] md:leading-[1.28], tracking-tight, mt-2 mb-10 max-w-3xl, then a flex flex-col items-center gap-3 author block: a grid-place-items-center w-16 h-16 rounded-full GRADIENT monogram avatar (bg-gradient-to-br: from-burgundy to-burgundy-deep / from-ink to-ink-soft / from-burgundy-deep to-ink) with cream Fraunces text-xl initials, ring-4 ring-cream, and a soft shadow-lg burgundy/ink-tinted; below it a 0.95rem font-medium ink name and a 14px ink-soft role. Render THREE slides (Mara Reyes - Founder, Tideline; Devin Kwon - Indie hacker, builds in public; Amara Okafor - Product designer, Northwind). CONTROLS (mt-12 flex items-center justify-center gap-8): a prev button + a #dots row + a next button. Each control is a .ctrl-btn grid-place-items-center w-12 h-12 rounded-full border border-ink/15 bg-cream text-ink with a stroked caret arrow SVG, hover:bg-ink hover:text-cream (and translateY(-2px) on hover). The #dots row is flex items-center gap-3 of .dot buttons (w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full) where the active dot is bg-burgundy and animates its width to 28px (a pill) over .35s and the rest are bg-ink/20.

A full-bleed inverted band: section bg-ink #1c1815 text-cream. Inside a centered max-w-6xl px-6 md:px-10 py-16 md:py-20, a grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-10 sm:gap-6 text-center with sm:divide-x divide-cream/10. Three stats, each a px-4 column: a Fraunces font-light text-5xl md:text-6xl cream numeral with a burgundy accent suffix ('57k' + burgundy '+', '<60' + burgundy 's', '4.9' + burgundy '/5'), over an mt-3 text-sm cream/60 tracking-wide label ('designers on the canvas', 'prompt to first mockup', 'average maker rating').

A 'grain' cream section, centered max-w-6xl px-6 md:px-10 py-20 md:py-28. Header (text-center max-w-2xl mx-auto): an 11px uppercase tracking-[0.2em] burgundy label 'Idea to interface', then an mt-4 Fraunces (soft optical) font-light text-4xl md:text-5xl tracking-tight heading 'Three steps, one canvas'. Then an mt-14 grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-6 of three cards, each rounded-2xl border border-ink/10 bg-cream-2/50 p-8: a Fraunces burgundy text-3xl step number ('01'/'02'/'03'), an mt-4 mb-2 Fraunces text-2xl font-normal title ('Describe it' / 'Watch it fan out' / 'Ship the code'), and an ink-soft leading-relaxed 0.95rem body line.

A full-bleed burgundy #7b2d3b band, text-cream, centered max-w-4xl px-6 md:px-10 py-20 md:py-24 text-center: a Fraunces (soft optical) font-light text-4xl md:text-5xl tracking-tight headline 'Your testimonial goes here next.', an mt-5 cream/75 max-w-lg mx-auto sub, then an mt-9 inline-flex rounded-full bg-cream text-burgundy-deep font-medium px-7 py-3.5 button 'Start designing' with a stroked up-right arrow, hover:bg-ink hover:text-cream. Then a footer: border-t border-ink/10, centered max-w-6xl px-6 md:px-10 py-10, flex (col -> sm:row) items-center justify-between gap-4 text-sm ink-soft: left = a small w-7 h-7 rounded-full burgundy logo tile + quote glyph beside a Fraunces text-lg 'Praise.' wordmark; center = a tagline 'An AI product design agent. Idea to shippable UI.'; right = a faded '© 2026'.

special_ui_components.prompt: One-quote-at-a-time testimonial carousel: absolutely-stacked .slide articles where only .is-active is visible; slides cross-fade with opacity + a 14px translateY rise over .6s cubic-bezier(.22,.61,.36,1); a small JS engine tracks the index, toggles .is-active, and auto-advances every 6.5s (restarting the timer on any manual interaction).

Animated dot/pill indicators: a row of w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full .dot buttons where the active dot turns burgundy and animates its width to 28px (stretching into a pill) over .35s, the rest stay bg-ink/20; clicking a dot jumps to that slide.

Circular .ctrl-btn prev/next controls: w-12 h-12 rounded-full cream buttons with ink/15 borders and stroked caret-arrow SVGs that invert to bg-ink/text-cream and lift translateY(-2px) on hover; ArrowLeft/ArrowRight keys also drive them.

Gradient monogram avatars: w-16 h-16 rounded-full bg-gradient-to-br tiles (from-burgundy to-burgundy-deep / from-ink to-ink-soft / from-burgundy-deep to-ink) holding cream Fraunces initials, ring-4 ring-cream, with a soft burgundy/ink-tinted shadow-lg.

Soft-optical Fraunces display type: all headlines, the wordmark, blockquotes, stat numerals, and step numbers use Fraunces at font-light 300 with font-optical-sizing:auto and font-variation-settings 'SOFT' 40,'WONK' 0 (a .fraunces-soft class), tracking-tight.
Custom double-quote-mark SVG glyph reused at three scales: a 15px cream version inside the burgundy logo tile, a 68px burgundy/25 version above each slide, and a 13px version in the footer logo.
Eyebrow pill: an inline-flex rounded-full border-burgundy/30 bg-burgundy/5 chip with a leading burgundy dot and uppercase 0.18em-tracked burgundy micro-label.

Full-bleed inverted bands: a dark-ink (#1c1815) 3-up stats strip with cream numerals + burgundy accent suffixes and sm:divide-x dividers, and a solid burgundy (#7b2d3b) CTA band with cream text and a cream button.
Faint radial-dot 'grain' texture behind the cream sections: background-image radial-gradient(rgba(28,24,21,0.035) 1px, transparent 1px); background-size 4px 4px.
Animated nav-link underline: each desktop nav link grows a 1px burgundy ::after underline from width 0 to 100% over .3s on hover and darkens from ink-soft to ink.

structured.special_notes: The whole point is an EDITORIAL TESTIMONIAL CAROUSEL in a warm premium-print idiom: a cream paper page (#faf6ef over #f3ecdf cards), warm near-black ink text (#1c1815) with a soft-brown ink-soft (#4a423b) for body, and a single deep-burgundy accent (#7b2d3b, darker burgundy-deep #5e1f2b for gradient stops) reserved for intent: the logo tile, the eyebrow, the italic headline word, the quote mark, the avatar gradients, the active dot, and the full-bleed CTA. The carousel shows ONE quote at a time, centered and large, cross-fading with a gentle 14px rise; wayfinding is circular prev/next arrows + a dot row whose active dot stretches into a 28px burgundy pill, and it auto-advances every 6.5s + responds to arrow keys. Two full-bleed bands invert the palette (a dark-ink stats strip, a burgundy CTA) to punctuate the otherwise quiet cream rhythm. Typography is the signature: Fraunces (a soft-optical serif, 'SOFT' 40 'WONK' 0) at a LIGHT 300 weight carries every display element while Inter (400/500/600) carries nav/body/labels. Depth stays soft and quiet, never hard: a faint 4px radial-dot 'grain' texture behind the cream sections, a ring-4 cream + soft shadow on the gradient avatars, ink/10 hairline borders, and slow .35-.6s cubic-bezier(.22,.61,.36,1) motion (the slide cross-fade, the dot-to-pill width, the nav underline, the control-button lift). Chrome corners are pill-round (logo, nav pills, arrows, dots, avatar); the how-it-works cards are rounded-2xl. Icons are inline SVG only (a custom double-quote-mark glyph + stroked caret/arrow icons). Built with Tailwind (CDN) using a custom theme (cream / cream-2 / ink / ink-soft / burgundy / burgundy-deep tokens + Fraunces/Inter families), with the .slide/.dot motion, the .grain texture, the .nav-link underline, and the .ctrl-btn hover defined in a small <style> block and a ~30-line vanilla-JS carousel engine.
